title: Add private beta workflow-run verifier
summary: Add a read-only verifier for completed private beta GitHub Actions workflow runs and uploaded CI artifacts.
reason: After dispatching the private beta workflow, operators need a repeatable check that the selected workflow run completed successfully and produced the expected channel-scoped artifact before publishing or validating GitHub Release assets.
behavior_before: The dispatch helper could submit the workflow and list the latest run, but there was no offline-testable or GitHub-backed gate for run conclusion and uploaded workflow artifact posture.
behavior_after: Operators can validate a private beta workflow run from `gh api` or saved JSON fixtures, including completed/success status, workflow dispatch event, run identity, and the expected channel artifact.
manual_validation: pytest tests/python/tooling -k private_beta -q - passed (21 passed, 148 deselected)
rollback_plan: Remove the workflow-run verifier script, tests, docs references, generated summaries, and this change packet.
notes: This verifier must not cancel, rerun, approve, upload, download, delete, or publish workflow runs or artifacts. Unit tests must run without live GitHub access.
